notes.title: A small update to the Demo today
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439460/2e3a98c2605c1fe107fd5b15371b92e80750d1b2.png[/img]
Based on feedback from enthusiastic players, I’ve made a small update to the Demo today.

The laser sword no longer requires equipment; it can be activated by pressing F while in the backpack.
Added storage boxes at two key locations.
Optimized and changed the number and location of some items.
Fixed the bug where the character's backpack would slide open when accessed.

Thank you for your support and feedback, and I hope you enjoy the game! 
Please leave feedback or suggestions if you have any, and once again, thank you!

notes.title: 《SNOWY MEMORIES》Demo is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439460/30194ee30616173268f8cb9a26423677182e4cf8.png[/img]
Hello everyone!

[b]《SNOWY MEMORIES》Demo is now available![/b]  

This trial version is mainly designed to give everyone a sneak peek at the weapons and core gameplay. It does not represent the final product, as the game is still in development.
There are many areas in the Demo that can be improved, and we hope to collect your feedback to further optimize the gaming experience!

The weapons currently featured in the Demo include:

Teleportation Bomb, Zero-Gravity Bomb, Intrusion Bomb, Teleportation Beacon, Deep Spirit Jammer, Global Needle Burst Bomb, Black Hole Detonation Bomb!
Six types of enemies!
Plus a hidden location!

Currently, the gameplay duration is approximately 20 to 40 minutes. Due to the short length, no save points have been set.

If you are interested, [b]please add it to your wishlist![/b]
Stay tuned, [b]you can find me on Bilibili, Steam developer quan_home, Afdian, and QQ 375438347[/b].

Thank you all for your support!
